001: Have you prepared your trip to Lyon?
Yes, I booked the train and the hotel yesterday.
Did you think about printing the documents for the meeting?
Good idea, I'll put them in my briefcase right away.
And for transportation there, have you planned something?
Yes, I'll take the metro, it's the simplest.
002: When are you leaving for the Bordeaux trade fair?
I'm taking the train Thursday morning, very early.
Did you book a hotel near the exhibition center?
Yes, it's a ten-minute walk from there, it's perfect.
Do you need help preparing your things?
No thanks, I'm used to traveling light.
003: Did you see the agenda for the trip to Nantes?
Yes, we have two client meetings and a factory tour.
Did you prepare the presentations for those meetings?
Almost, I just need to finalize the numbers.
Do you think we'll have time to have lunch?
Yes, I booked a restaurant near the second client.
004: Did you think about checking the weather for your trip?
Not yet, did you see anything?
Apparently it's going to rain in Lille, take an umbrella.
Thanks for the tip, I'll add it to my suitcase.
Did you also plan a plan B for transportation?
Yes, I wrote down the bus schedules in case of a strike.
005: Did you book your ticket for the conference in Marseille?
Yes, I got a train ticket for Tuesday afternoon.
Do you need a receipt for your trip?
Yes, I filled out the request, I just need your signature.
I'll sign it right away, no problem.
Thanks, I'll send it to the accounting department today.
006: Did you prepare your speech for the conference in Strasbourg?
Yes, I finished the main outline last night.
Do you want me to read it over and give you my opinion?
With pleasure, I'd appreciate an outside perspective.
I'll give it back to you tomorrow morning with my comments.
Perfect, I'll still have time to make adjustments.
007: Did you think about booking a rental car in Toulouse?
No, I was thinking of taking the tram from the station.
It's true that it's convenient, but with our suitcases...
You're right, I'll book a car for more comfort.
Did you check the booking conditions?
Yes, cancellation is free until the day before, that's reassuring.
008: Did you prepare the business cards for the trip?
Yes, I took two boxes, one for each day.
Did you also plan some company brochures?
Of course, I put about thirty of them in my suitcase.
Do you think that's enough for the three days?
I think so, but I can ask for more if needed.
009: Did you confirm your meeting with the client in Rennes?
Yes, I sent an email to confirm the time.
Did you prepare answers to his possible questions?
I prepared a few points, but I can still improve.
Do you want to do a mock interview?
Excellent idea, we can practice tomorrow afternoon.
010: Did you think about letting the team know about your absence?
Yes, I sent a message on the group chat yesterday.
Did you also designate someone to cover for you?
Yes, Camille will handle the urgent matters while I'm away.
Did you give her the necessary access?
Yes, I gave her all the passwords and the key contacts.
